parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses a specific issue with the `units.quantity_input` decorator when used with constructors that have a return type of `None`. The patch is minimal and directly targets the problem.

issues.description: The patch introduces a special case for constructors with a return type of `None`, which may not be sufficient to handle all edge cases or other scenarios where the decorator is used.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify that the fix works as expected and does not introduce any regressions.
